messages:
maria_brightcart: Hey team — heads up: after last night's canary (model: redwood/v3-small:shorter_tone), our checkout assistant responses became noticeably curt and sometimes drop salutations. Putting one minimal example inline; I DM'd redacted logs to support.

maria_brightcart: Example before rollout:
```
User: I just changed my shipping address, can you confirm?
Assistant: Thanks! I've updated your shipping address to 123 Main St. Is there anything else I can help with?
```
Example after rollout:
```
User: I just changed my shipping address, can you confirm?
Assistant: Done.
```

alex_cs: Sorry for the regression — can you paste the request_id from one of the failing calls and the exact request payload (redact any PII)? Also we need the model string, temperature, top_p, system messages, and whether streaming was used.

maria_brightcart: Request header snippet: `x-request-id: rc-7890abcd`
API call: `POST /v1/chat/completions` with body: `{"model":"redwood/v3-small:shorter_tone","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"I just changed my shipping address, can you confirm?"}],"temperature":0.7,"max_tokens":60}`

omar_ml: Thanks — a couple asks to triage quickly: 1) Can you run a minimal deterministic repro (temperature=0.0, top_p=1.0, max_tokens=60, stream=false) with the exact system message you use? 2) Share the prompt logs (redacted) and the model build/hash if available. We pushed a 'shorter_tone' system profile during the canary; need to confirm whether it aggressively removes closings when user messages are short.

maria_brightcart: Attaching redacted prompt logs in support ticket. Quick paste of the most recent raw assistant response for rc-7890abcd:
```
{"id":"rc-7890abcd","model":"redwood/v3-small:shorter_tone","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Done."}}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":32,"completion_tokens":3}}
```
I'll run the minimal repro you requested and paste the result shortly.

alex_cs: I pulled the logs you uploaded — I can see the system message in the canary payload was switched to a shorter template. Omar, fyi. @maria_brightcart if the minimal repro reproduces the curt reply, please include the full curl command and response so we can attach it to the incident.

omar_ml: Confirmed the canary applied the shorter_tone profile to ~5% traffic last night. It's supposed to reduce verbosity, not remove salutations entirely. I will run internal tests with the exact system message. In the meantime, can you run this curl (replace API_KEY and request-id) and paste the JSON output?
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "X-Request-ID: rc-debug-0001" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/v3-small:shorter_tone","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"I just changed my shipping address, can you confirm?"}],"temperature":0.0,"top_p":1.0,"max_tokens":60,"stream":false}'
```

maria_brightcart: Ran the curl above (subbed our key) — response below, matches the terse reply. Posting full response in support ticket attachment  #4521.
```
{"id":"rc-debug-0001","model":"redwood/v3-small:shorter_tone","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Done."}}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":32,"completion_tokens":3}}
```
Thanks — I'll keep the ticket updated with any additional examples. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout applied: redwood/v3-small:shorter_tone -> 5% traffic at 2025-11-01T03:20:00Z

alex_cs: Thanks, team. Omar — please advise next steps after internal repro. I'll flag the support ticket for priority escalation if internal repro matches customer behavior.
__notes: This file is a single Slack thread string; messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names.
